name: LAYERED autonomous plastering robot
summary: Light mobile robot that scans a wall and sprays plaster or coatings while it moves, with the work areas chosen in an XR app on an iPhone. Made by LAYERED, an ETH Zurich spin-off in Lupfig, Switzerland; used on Swiss and French sites since 2025.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route found. LAYERED says a first series is in production and a commercial deployment phase starts in Switzerland in September 2026; it has run paid proofs of concept with a French general contractor and a first French site deployment (June 2026). Contact via the Swiss maker only.

specs.label: Process
specs.value: spray-based printing-in-motion of plaster or coatings, planned autonomously
specs.quote: Our robot autonomously plans and executes spray-based printing-in-motion—the first of its kind in the industry.

specs.label: Operation
specs.value: XR interface on a standard iPhone
specs.quote: controlled through an intuitive XR interface on a standard iPhone

notes: The robot scans the wall; the worker picks the surfaces to treat in a simple interface; the robot then applies plaster or coating (CEO profile).
Mobile base with one spray arm assumed from the description of a light mobile robot; drive type not stated.
Also tested for facade upgrading in a proof of concept for the European Commission JRC in Ispra, Italy (funder page).
